P.flaw: Noodle cart is cluttered with an oversized wheel and the pot is hidden under the awning.

Q.flaw: Cat has no outline and almost no visible curled tail, so it blends into the dark ground.

R.flaw: Cat tail is missing and the cart is a confusing blob with one wheel and an unclear pot.

P.flaw: Gardener's watering can and body are slightly stiff and the packet's folded top is only a flat band.

Q.flaw: Gardener and packet lack a full dark outline, so they read weakly against the pale wall.

R.flaw: Green shirt hides the brown apron and the watering can is red, so the gardener's apron is hard to read.

S.flaw: Packet is thin and small at play size and the tomato icon is tiny.

art-2.why_top: P meets every brief point with clean dark outlines, a clearly brown apron and straw hat, six readable seedlings, a seamless brick tile and a legible packet.
